assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction. Create a GAME-READY transparent rear-valley defence layer for AZMARA, matching the approved B2 concept. INPUT 1 is the exact existing AZMARA transparent canyon/cliff asset and must remain the base composition, 1536x1024 landscape. Preserve its two broad orange sandstone shoulders, open central valley, warm upper-left lighting, dimetric 2.5D painted miniature style, vegetation, rock ledges, silhouette, placement, transparent padding, and clean alpha. INPUT 2 is AZMARA's approved B2 full-town concept and is STYLE/COMPOSITION REFERENCE ONLY for how the finished fortification is embedded into the canyon and how the central road opening reads. Do not copy any town buildings, roads, ground, or UI from Input 2. Edit Input 1 by constructing ONE mature sandstone canyon defence INTO and ALONG the natural front ledges of both cliff shoulders. The wall must feel architecturally embedded in the rock, not a separate flat wall pasted across sand. It should trace the existing ledge line with a gently stepped oblique/dimetric route and visible top surfaces. Both outer wall ends disappear naturally into rock ledges. One broad centered arched caravan gate opens through the middle valley pass; make the opening about 1.45 times the old/reference opening so a wide ceremonial caravan boulevard can pass through clearly. Exactly TWO principal gate towers flank the arch, plus up to two much smaller integrated lookout turrets at far cliff ledges as part of the same defence line—no repeated copy-paste modules, no ring, no foreground wall, no side returns around a city. The main two towers should sit on rock outcrops with rubble foundations and soft lower-right contact shadows. Warm dressed sandstone/adobe trim, restrained teal awnings/banners, no red flags. Keep the lower/southern half almost entirely transparent so independent roads and buildings can render below. No broad sand slab. No buildings, people, empty plots, roads, palms outside those already on the cliffs, UI, text, labels, water, boats, gods, religious symbols, logo, or watermark. No black/white/checkerboard background. Output genuine RGBA transparency, same 1536x1024 canvas if supported, complete uncropped silhouette and clean natural edges with no red/yellow speckle fringe.
